summary: M1 Med Beauty has clear treatment categories, a free consultation and a persistent Book Now button. A location error and no proof reduce confidence in a doctor led clinic.

findings.problem: The Melbourne paragraph says M1 Med Beauty Melbourne is located in Dymocks Building Suite 12, but gives a Sydney address on George Street. No Melbourne address appears.
findings.cost: A patient who reads the wrong address may go to the wrong clinic, and it makes the page look careless.

findings.problem: No reviews, testimonials or before and after images appear, and no doctors are named, even though the page says experienced and qualified doctors perform treatments.
findings.cost: Injectable patients decide on proof and on who treats them. Without it, the claim is just words.
findings.fix: Named doctors with credentials, reviews and captioned results.

findings.problem: Booking is a separate page with no form or chat. CTA wording varies (Book NOW, Book now, BOOK YOUR FREE CONSULTATION), and the free consultation is not explained.
findings.cost: A patient is unsure what they get for free and how to claim it.
findings.fix: A short booking form and one clear free consultation offer.

findings.problem: Treatment lists repeat in the menus and again in the main section, the heading Aesthetic treatments appears twice, and hours show Monday to Friday only.
findings.cost: Repeated lists make the page long, and missing weekend hours cost bookings.
findings.fix: A simpler page and clear opening hours.

redesign: A proof first homepage with named doctors, reviews and captioned results beside every booking button.
A clean booking form, a clear free consultation offer and correct clinic details.
